text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan reshuffles cabinet and appoints four women as state secretaries.
- Former leader of opposition Progress and Socialism party Si Ali Yata buried in Casablanca.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak to hold talks with King Hassan in December in Assouan, Egypt, on the occasion of joint high commission meeting.
- Moroccan society inaugurates new era after King Hassan appointed four women as state secretaries.
- With $1.4 billion turnover in 1996, the giant Office Cherifien des Phosphates confirms its international phosphates exporting strategy.
- European Union experts call on Morocco for a technical meeting on fishing issues.
- State-owned mining firm BRPM research activity improves in 1996.
